title: The last human play session no longer replays to its autosave
tier_reason: Replays reproducing the same end state is one of the load-bearing rules the whole phase-4 plan rests on, and the check that proves it is failing on main.
ask:
`godot --headless --path . --script res://tools/verify_replay.gd` fails on origin/main as of 2026-09-19 (commit f5b4afb). Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to that night's Q-110 work: the identical failure reproduces from a clean worktree at origin/main against the same user://slot1 data, and the Q-110 changes were exonerated by that comparison.

What it reports, verbatim:
  farm: user://slot1, replay entries: 2265 (base_save: no), format v2, sim time 5526 ticks
  MISMATCH: recomputation diverged from the recording.
    entry 1: recorded @37 {actor=raid_crow_0,target=10,10,verb=eat_crop}, recomputed (nothing recomputed)
  MISMATCH: replay end state differs from autosave.

So the very first recomputed entry is already wrong: on replay the raid crow does not decide to eat at tick 37 at all. Everything after that is downstream of one brain decision that did not come back. Suspect the raid's clock change (Q-105, commit 529d76a) — the raid birds no longer eat on a timer and instead fire off a shoo report, which means a replay has to reach that trigger from the recorded log rather than from elapsed ticks. Start by reading CrowBrain's raid branch and `ReplayLog._apply_v2`, and find out what state at tick 37 the recomputation is missing.

Note the provenance line is not the problem, though it will distract: the build_id recorded in the session and the one committed in project.godot are both stale strings, because project.godot's build_id is rewritten whenever the game runs and sometimes gets committed. Treat that as noise and fix the determinism.

This check has no CI job, which is why it went unnoticed — decide as part of this whether it should have one, given it needs a recorded human session to verify against.
first_action: From a clean worktree at origin/main, run tools/verify_replay.gd to see the failure, then instrument the raid branch of systems/sim/brains/crow_brain.gd to print what it sees at tick 37 in the recording and in the recomputation.
source_message: Found on 2026-09-19 while running the full gate before committing the Q-110 build.
